items.title: 全日空商事でギフト不正交換 原因は第三者の不正アクセス
items.summary: 法人向けデジタルギフトサービス「選べるe-GIFT」を提供する全日空商事は、同サービスへの不正アクセスに起因して、一部の「選べるe-GIFT」が第三者に不正交換されていたと公表した。原因箇所を特定して必要な修正を終え、停止していたサービスを2026年9月4日午後2時に再開した。
items.whyItMatters: 法人向けデジタルギフトサービス「選べるe-GIFT」を提供する全日空商事は、同サービスへの不正アクセスに起因して、一部の「選べるe-GIFT」が第三者に不正交換されていたと公表した。原因箇所を特定して必要な修正を終え、停止していたサービスを2026年9月4日午後
items.titleEn: All Nippon Airways Shoji unauthorized gift exchange—Third-party unauthorized access identified as cause
items.summaryEn: All Nippon Airways Shoji, which operates corporate digital gift service "Eraberu e-GIFT," disclosed unauthorized access to the service resulting in third-party fraudulent redemptions of some gift codes. After identifying and fixing the vulnerability, the company resumed service on September 4, 2026, at 2:00 PM.
items.whyItMattersEn: Rapid disclosure and remediation of unauthorized access incidents demonstrates good security incident response practices and helps minimize customer impact.
items.actionItemEn: Organizations offering digital gift or transaction services should strengthen access controls and implement continuous security monitoring to prevent similar incidents.
items.pickerCommentEn: The incident highlights the security risks of digital transaction platforms and the importance of multi-factor authentication for high-value transactions.

items.title: 格下でリストラ続きだったIT部門 経営戦略の要へと復活できるか
items.summary: 多くの企業のIT部門がシステムの内製力を失って久しい。理由は極めて単純だ。少なくとも2000年代までIT部門の地位が、一部の小売業や金融機関などを除けばあまりにも低かったからだ。
items.whyItMatters: 多くの企業のIT部門がシステムの内製力を失って久しい。理由は極めて単純だ。
items.titleEn: IT departments losing clout and facing layoffs—Can they reclaim their role as strategic business drivers?
items.summaryEn: Many corporate IT departments have long lost in-house system development capabilities. The reason is straightforward: until at least the 2000s, IT departments held low status in most organizations, with only a few exceptions in retail and finance.
items.whyItMattersEn: Revitalizing IT department strategic value is essential for organizations pursuing digital transformation and competing effectively in an AI-driven economy.
items.actionItemEn: C-suite executives should reassess IT department strategic importance and invest in talent, tools, and organizational authority to support business transformation goals.
items.pickerCommentEn: The trend toward IT modernization signals that organizations recognizing IT as strategic infrastructure rather than cost centers are gaining competitive advantages.
